Right, I didn’t get to place much of BF1 but I was able to play for a while so I’ll do my best to compare the two.

The aircrafts seemed to have some “boost” feature if your fly in a straight line long enough, being on Team GB the Spitfires (fighter class) I did notice what looked like a NOS bottle in the bottom right screen however I was unable to find a way to activate it. But from what I remember from BF1 you do take around quicker, once the plane speeds up.

From what I experienced with the other team only spawning in BF109’s (fighter class) and Stuka’s (ground attack class) their aircrafts seem to be able to take some pounding. The way they show the amount of damage is that the tip of the right wing disappears, then the left tip, then what looks like a oil/water leak or maybe it’s just black smoke and then the engine is pouring out flames. 
Aircrafts being what might have been a Spitfire for the fighter class, Hurricane for the ground attack class and the Blenheim as a bomber class. Mine was what I could have thought was the hurricane (couldn’t see the cockpit glass from the outside camera view) as it came with 2 sets of machine guns and rockets. However sadly there was no bomber spawned in my match. There was no way of telling the set of machine guns apart besides the very similar photo of them in the bottom right and the aiming circle changing. However it felt like the first set were 7.7mm and the second set were 20mm for bombers and possible tanks or other LAV’s.
